hints.title: Word Separation by Spaces
hints.text: Words are separated by single spaces; scan for spaces or split into a word array.

hints.title: Prefix Slice
hints.text: Take the first k elements of the word array and join them with spaces.

hints.title: Single Pass Index Scan
hints.text: Alternatively, find the position of the k-th space and return the prefix substring before it.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full string parsing and array allocation is already linear, but in-place index search can optimize space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear scan to k-th space computes the truncated sentence in O(n) time and minimal memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles cases where k equals total words gracefully.
